_comment: B8 deterministic replay fixture: a single outbound USDT-TRC20 transfer from a watched TRON wallet, above the A1 HIGH threshold. Shaped as workers/adapters TransferPage.items (Transfer[]) and fed to a fake ChainAdapter in tests -- not a B0 record/replay HTTP fixture (see B8 report: fabricating a byte-correct TronGrid fixture requires either a live call or reverse-engineering the request-hash algorithm, out of scope/forbidden without a live-call go-ahead). The fake adapter conforms to the same ChainAdapter interface B3 already tests. Addresses are real Base58Check-valid TRON addresses (deterministically derived, not on-chain) so they pass classifyIdentifier in integration tests that go through the real WatchlistService.
